name: 道の駅 歓遊舎ひこさん
desc: 福岡県添田町にある道の駅「歓遊舎ひこさん」は、霊山・英彦山の麓に位置します。最大の特徴は、モノライダーなどの遊具を備えた「こどもわくわくパーク」を併設し、家族連れで思い切り遊べること。また、駅（現在はBRT）と直結する珍しい道の駅でもあります。特産品は、豊かな自然が育んだ新鮮な野菜や山菜をはじめ、手作りの柚子こしょうやこんにゃくが大人気。大自然の中で遊びと山の幸を満喫できる憩いのスポットです。
descEn: Located at the foot of the sacred Mt. Hiko in Soeda Town, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Kanyusha Hikosan" is a fantastic destination for families. Its greatest feature is the adjacent "Children's Wakuwaku Park," which is equipped with playground equipment like the Mono-rider. It is also a rare roadside station directly connected to a transit station (currently a BRT station). Local specialties include fresh vegetables and mountain greens nurtured by the rich natural environment, as well as highly popular handmade yuzu pepper and konjac. It is a relaxing spot where you can fully enjoy playing in nature and savoring mountain delicacies.
